Nina (Finance): Customer Nimbus flagged an invoice weirdness for April: duplicate PDF and a -$75 credit that doesn't match any refund.
Ravi (Billing): Which invoice id?
Tess (Support): INC-5019 attached: INV-2026-04-5532 and INV-2026-04-5532-dup both sent. They say totals differ by $75.
Gabe (Recon): quick db pull: INV-2026-04-5532 lines: usage 620.00, reserved_discount -120.00 total 500.00. INV-2026-04-5532-dup lines: usage 620.00, reserved_discount -195.00 total 425.00. There's an extra -75 on the dup.
Ravi (Billing): that -75 smells like a proration overlap credit. Any recent proration retries?
BillingBot: SCHEDULE: billing-runner/prorate_and_finalize started 2026-04-01T03:02:11Z (run_id br-20260401-03-02)\nSCHEDULE: billing-runner/prorate_and_finalize started 2026-04-01T03:02:47Z (run_id br-20260401-03-02-retry)
Gabe (Recon): same pattern as prior incidents. Looks like the retry applied a second discount.
Nina (Finance): OK — action: Ravi please revert the extra -$75 on the duplicate invoice, consolidate PDFs, and Draft an apology note. Gabe add a quick alert for duplicate invoice ids within 5 minutes. Tess please update customer ETA ~3 hours.
